Restricted cross-slip/recovery leads to dislocation pile-up and limited twin formation, increasing yield strength and reducing ductility.
Enhanced cross-slip/recovery lowers flow stress and maintains ductility.
The stacking fault energy of FeNiCrMn governs the evolving dislocation configurations and twin boundaries.
